s = input()
decoded = ""
length = len(s)
i = 0

while i < length:
    if i + 3 <= length and s[i:i+3] == "dot":
        decoded += '.'
        i += 3
    elif i + 2 <= length and s[i:i+2] == "at":
        decoded += '@'
        i += 2
    else:
        decoded += s[i]
        i += 1

# Remove leading dot or at and prepend "dot" or "at"
if decoded and (decoded[0] == '.' or decoded[0] == '@'):
    first_char = decoded[0]
    decoded = decoded[1:]
    if first_char == '.':
        decoded = "dot" + decoded
    else:
        decoded = "at" + decoded

# Remove trailing dot or at and append "dot" or "at"
if decoded and (decoded[-1] == '.' or decoded[-1] == '@'):
    last_char = decoded[-1]
    decoded = decoded[:-1]
    if last_char == '.':
        decoded += "dot"
    else:
        decoded += "at"

# Count '@' characters
at_count = decoded.count('@')

if at_count == 1:
    print(decoded)
else:
    first = True
    result = ""
    for c in decoded:
        if c == '@':
            if first:
                result += '@'
                first = False
            else:
                result += "at"
        else:
            result += c
    print(result)
</translated_code>
